fields.description: Turns on simulation submissions to the isolated OpenFOAM provider. Runs execute in the provider's own container and never touch plant equipment, SCADA or an ERP.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Base URL of the foames-openfoam provider service (bridges/openfoam), for example http://openfoam-worker:8765. Must be reachable from this site only.
fields.label: Provider URL

fields.description: Bearer token the provider requires, when configured. Stored encrypted; never logged.
fields.label: Provider Token

fields.description: Per-request timeout in seconds for provider calls.
fields.label: Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: A converged solve is candidate evidence only: results still need human review against the Validation Protocol's acceptance criteria.
fields.label: Note
